nautilus.yaml:
name: sealin
server:
  online-edits: true
tasks:
  - program: program.ld
    scan: 100ms
tags:
  - { name: StartPB, role: setpoint, type: BOOL, init: false, desc: "Start pushbutton (NO)" }
  - { name: StopPB,  role: setpoint, type: BOOL, init: false, desc: "Stop pushbutton (pressed = TRUE)" }
  - { name: Motor,   role: output,   type: BOOL, init: false, desc: "Motor run command" }
driver:
  type: memory
program.ld:
PROGRAM Sealin
(* Start/stop seal-in: Start latches the motor on through its own
   contact; Stop breaks the rung. *)
LD
  RUNG sealin (* start, or already running, and not stopped *)
    [ StartPB | Motor ] /StopPB ( Motor )
END_LD
END_PROGRAM
